sources.title: Hierarchical Reasoning Model
pinned_claims: strong reported performance on Sudoku, maze path finding, and ARC-style reasoning tasks

sources.title: Are Your Reasoning Models Reasoning or Guessing? A Mechanistic Analysis of Hierarchical Reasoning Models
pinned_claims: reports HRM failure modes and argues some behavior may be closer to guessing/fixed-point dynamics than reasoning
provides a critical guardrail against treating HRM headline results as settled foundation-model proof

sources.title: Dynamical Systems Theory Behind a Hierarchical Reasoning Model
pinned_claims: reports compact dynamical-systems alternatives outperforming HRM on Sudoku/Maze-style tasks
establishes that HRM is part of an active extreme-parameter-efficiency reasoning frontier, not a final endpoint

sources.title: Speedrunning Tabular Foundation Model Pretraining
pinned_claims: nanoTabPFN community speedrun on one NVIDIA L40S GPU
current best record 0.92 minutes to fixed downstream ROC AUC target

baseline_scope.allowed: Use Sapient HRM as a data-efficiency and compact-reasoning architecture anchor; use modded-nanoTabPFN as a tabular foundation-model pretraining speed/data-efficiency anchor.
baseline_scope.disallowed: Do not use HRM as proof of broad >=1B language foundation-model pretraining on one RTX 4090, and do not use tabular foundation pretraining as a substitute for language-model or Ember self-improvement claims.

correction: The prior baseline over-weighted raw LM speedrun and general sample-efficiency anchors while under-weighting extreme data-efficiency records. Sapient HRM and modded-nanoTabPFN must be represented as separate frontier anchors with explicit transfer limits.
